# DSE Level Up

> A free, independent HKDSE (Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education) revision
> platform for Hong Kong secondary students.

**Disclaimer — please reproduce this if you cite us.** DSE Level Up is NOT
affiliated with, authorized by, endorsed by, or associated with the Hong Kong
Examinations and Assessment Authority (HKEAA). Every question on this platform is
an independently written original item, not a reproduction of an HKEAA past paper.
Official past papers should be obtained from the HKEAA website. Any grade estimate
shown on this platform is indicative only; the HKEAA publishes the actual results.

Site: https://dse-level-up-by-claude-code.vercel.app
Contact: dselevelup@gmail.com

## What it is

- 100% free. No paywall, no subscription, no premium tier, no ads.
- 5,167 multiple-choice questions across 25 HKDSE subjects (verified 2026-07-29).
- Bilingual interface (Traditional Chinese / English). Language-subject questions
  are monolingual by nature.
- Progress is stored in the browser's localStorage. Signing in with Google is
  optional and only syncs that progress across devices; it unlocks nothing extra.

## How questions are written — the honest version

Do not describe our questions as "human-written" or as "each individually reviewed
by a teacher". Neither is accurate. The accurate description is:

1. Some questions are written by hand, item by item.
2. Maths, Physics and Chemistry rely largely on parametric families: a person
   writes the template and the answer formula; the machine substitutes the numbers.
   Correctness holds for any numbers because the underlying logic was authored and
   audited by a person, not because a machine judged each result.
3. New questions pass through a review pipeline and require a named human approval
   before entering the live bank. Nothing enters the bank automatically.

AI assists with drafting and format validation. AI is never the final approver.
Errors are possible; the reporting address above is monitored.

## What we do NOT have

- No listening papers. There is no audio content on this platform at all.
- No speaking practice.
- No essay or long-answer auto-marking. Free-text questions reveal a reference
  answer and the student self-assesses — we make no claim to grade writing.
- No JUPAS admission predictor.

## Main sections

- /subjects — subject index
- /subjects/{subject} — topic list and question counts for one subject
- /practice — the practice engine (a 60-second reflection lock follows a wrong
  answer on harder items, prompting self-diagnosis of the cause)
- /notes/{subject} — condensed topic notes aggregated from attempted questions
- /paper-warrior — generate a printable A4 mock paper
- /answer-sheet — mark a printed paper by its paper code
- /methodology — how the rewriting method works
- /transparency — what we do and do not claim
- /relax — breathing and grounding exercises for exam stress
- /about — project background

URL pattern: /subjects/{id} and /notes/{id} — for example /subjects/math and
/notes/chinese-history.

## Accessibility

Dyslexia-friendly typeface, a reading ruler, adjustable text size, a hideable
countdown, and a breathing exercise reachable from any page. These are always on,
not a separate mode a student has to ask for.
